articles.title: Grayscale quietly drops Cardano, Polkadot and Hedera ETF plans
articles.snippet: The asset manager said it no longer intends to proceed with the offerings. None became effective, and no securities were issued or sold.

articles.title: Reform UK chair calls for probe into SBF-linked donation: Report
articles.snippet: As the chairman of the Reform UK calls for an investigation into a FTX-linked political donation, the party’s leader prepares to face voters amid his own crypto-related scandal.
